name_en: Zhang Shoucheng/Stanford/Quantum Physics/Investment/Tech for Nation/Zhang Shoucheng Fund/Quantum Computing
description_zh: 张首晟 (1963-2018) 斯坦福大学物理学教授，量子反常霍尔效应发现者，丹华资本创始人以"科技报国" 理念投资中国硬科技（量子计算/人工智能/新材料/生物技术），斯坦福-中国桥梁连接硅谷创新与中国产业，英年早逝留下量子计算与科技报国双重遗产。
description_en: Zhang Shoucheng (1963-2018) Stanford physics professor, quantum anomalous Hall effect discoverer, Danhua Capital founder with tech for nation philosophy investing in China hard tech (quantum computing/AI/new materials/biotech), Stanford-China bridge connecting Silicon Valley innovation with Chinese industry, early death leaving quantum computing and tech-for-nation dual legacy.
reason_zh: 张首晟代表海外顶尖华人科学家如何通过资本与技术双重桥梁服务祖国科技自立，展示了基础物理发现如何转化为产业投资指引，其量子反常霍尔效应奠定拓扑量子计算物理基础，丹华资本模式开创海外科学家服务祖国新范式。
reason_en: Zhang represents how overseas top Chinese scientists serve motherland tech self-reliance through capital and technology dual bridge, demonstrating how fundamental physics discovery transforms into industrial investment guidance, his quantum anomalous Hall effect laying topological quantum computing physics foundation, Danhua Capital model pioneering overseas scientists serving motherland new paradigm.
